blocked.name: Osagedoorn (Stadspark, Maasboulevard)
blocked.reason: LIKELY DEAD / NOT THE REGISTERED TREE: the LRMB register lists this Osage orange at Stadspark/Maasboulevard with a planted_band of 1880-1890, but IVN Maastricht's own Stadspark tree-walk page (https://www.ivn.nl/afdeling/maastricht/bomenwandeling-van-hemel-tot-fossiel/) states the park's Osage orange (Maclura pomifera/Goudappel) was 130 years old when it fell in October 2009, and was replaced with a new planting in 2011. If this register point is that same spot, the tree standing there today is a c.15-year-old replacement, not the historic specimen the register's date describes, and it is not yet a remarkable/collectible tree. The register carries no vitality field and was not updated to reflect the loss. Needs an on-the-ground or dated-aerial-imagery check before ever being considered again: confirm whether the current tree is the young 2011 replacement (block stands) or whether this register point is actually a different, still-living Osage orange elsewhere in the park (in which case re-open).
